name: knowledge_save
description: Save user-directed content to the global knowledge base with optional category and tags.

category.description: Category label (default: "user_memory"). Guideline: `common_sense`/`coding_guideline`/`preference`/`user_preference`/`safety_rules` for durable principles or constraints; `user_memory`/`project_info`/`architecture`/`decision_log` for factual knowledge.

source.description: Optional source context (e.g. user command, project name).

priority.description: Priority 0-255. 255=permanent, 100-200=high, 50-99=normal, 0-49=low. Default follows category: `user_memory`=150, guideline categories=210, `safety_rules`=255.
